components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Save to memory; disabled until a dump has been read.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn">Save to memory</button> <button class="ds-btn" disabled>Save to memory</button>
components.css: .ds-btn{font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:500;height:38px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid var(--ink, oklch(0.97 0 0));border-radius:6px;background:var(--ink, oklch(0.97 0 0));color:var(--ground, oklch(0.17 0 0))}.ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--ink-soft, oklch(0.755 0 0))}.ds-btn:disabled{background:transparent;color:var(--ink-soft, oklch(0.755 0 0));border-color:var(--ink-soft, oklch(0.755 0 0))}

components.name: Lamp Keys
components.css: .ds-lamps{display:flex;gap:8px;background:var(--surface, oklch(0.265 0 0));padding:4px}.ds-lamps button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:38px;padding:0 12px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:none;color:var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.66 0 0));font:500 15px 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-lamps i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:oklch(0.46 0 0)}.ds-lamps [aria-pressed=true],.ds-lamps button:hover{color:var(--ink, oklch(0.97 0 0))}.ds-lamps [aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ground, oklch(0.17 0 0))}.ds-lamps [aria-pressed=true] i{background:var(--ink, oklch(0.97 0 0))}

components.description: Keys of the half-moon rotor switch; the lever is drawn in SVG (src/ui/halfmoon.ts).
components.css: .ds-hm{display:flex;gap:24px;background:var(--surface, oklch(0.265 0 0));padding:12px}.ds-hm button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;height:24px;padding:0 7px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:none;color:var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.66 0 0));font:500 13px 'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-hm i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:oklch(0.37 0.066 27)}.ds-hm [aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ground, oklch(0.17 0 0));color:var(--ink, oklch(0.97 0 0))}.ds-hm [aria-pressed=true] i{background:var(--slow, oklch(0.8 0.21 147));box-shadow:0 0 4px var(--slow, oklch(0.8 0.21 147))}

narrative.overview: A dark, strictly neutral panel where color means only slow or fast; fine-line faders, a half-moon switch and one graph with both rotors on the same clock.
keyCharacteristics: Green is Slow, red is Fast, ink is Brake

rules.name: The Mode Rule
rules.body: Green is Slow, red is Fast, Brake and everything else use ink; rotors are told apart by place and name.

rules.name: The Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every ground, surface, text and outline has zero chroma.

rules.name: The LED Rule
rules.body: Slow green and fast red light the half-moon only; preset lights are ink.

dos: Show real units first; raw data lives in the guide.
Say what is calculated and what was read from the machine.
Keep every setting reachable through a standard control.
donts: No tinted neutrals, no wood, tolex or metal texture.
